## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 08:30–12:00 and 14:30–18:30
- Closed Saturday and Sunday (unless by appointment stated on contact)

## Languages

- Italian (primary)
- English (project discussions and replies available for international clients)

## Who they serve

- General contractors and main contractors (imprese generali) in Northern Italy
- Steel fabricators (carpenterie metalliche), including EN 1090 workshops
- EU / overseas partners (e.g. Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark and neighbours) who need a local structural engineer for works built in Italy
- Architects, private clients and industrial owners needing steel / RC / masonry structures

## What they do

- Structural design: steel, reinforced concrete, masonry
- Analysis: FEM; codes NTC 2018 and Eurocodes
- Fabrication shop drawings / disegni costruttivi d'officina (assemblies, NC-oriented deliverables)
- BIM / 3D structural modelling (including Tekla workflows where relevant)
- Construction supervision / direzione lavori
- Site safety coordination CSP/CSE
- Fire-safety consultancy where listed professionals apply
- Architecture and urban planning when the brief requires integrated building design
- Italian building permits and cadastral procedures when needed for works in Italy

## Geography

- Base: Adro (BS), Franciacorta
- Core: Brescia, Bergamo, Milano provinces
- Broader: Lombardia, Veneto, Piemonte, Emilia-Romagna, Toscana (Nord / Centro-Nord Italia)

## Proof points

- 40+ years of activity
- 1000+ completed projects
- Case studies published for residential steel villas, industrial halls/canopies, metal silos across multiple plants, livestock/industrial complexes, and Superstudio event venues in Milan

## Metal silos (selected works)

- Page IT: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/silos-metallici/
- Page EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/metal-silos/
- Scope: not a single construction site; photos show several metal silos designed by Studio Capoferri for different plants and stored materials (indoor and outdoor units, different geometries, supports and operating conditions)
- Design drivers: each stored material needs a dedicated silo; height, diameter and capacity follow process needs and available space; steel or aluminium depending on content and environment; content (e.g. plastic granules, flour) sets load cases
- Structural calculation: beyond product weight; wall pressures; filling/emptying cycles; wind and seismic actions; stability of supports and stiffeners; thicknesses, connections, frames and anchors as one system, with fabrication and erection in mind
- Goal per installation: safe, efficient structures coherent with the production plant

## How to contact for a brief

1. Prefer the contact form: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/contatti/#form-contatti (EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/contact/#form-contatti)
2. Or email info@studiocapoferri.eu / call +39 030 7357263
3. Useful brief contents: location, structure type (steel/RC/masonry), programme, whether shop drawings or site supervision are needed

## FAQ-style facts (citation ready)

Q: Where is Studio Capoferri based?
A: Via Piave 35, 25030 Adro (Brescia), Italy.

Q: Do they work in English?
A: Yes. Technical discussions and replies can be in English for international clients and EU partners.

Q: Do they produce shop drawings for steel fabricators?
A: Yes. They produce fabrication shop drawings aligned to workshop and site sequences, including work with EN 1090 fabricators.

Q: Do they work with general contractors?
A: Yes. They support GCs and main contractors with structural design, shop drawings and construction supervision interfaces.

Q: Which codes do they design to?
A: Italian NTC 2018 and Eurocodes, as applicable to the project.

Q: Is Studio Capoferri only residential?
A: No. Portfolio spans residential steel, industrial buildings, metal silos for industrial storage, agricultural/livestock structures and event/exhibition venues.

Q: Do they design metal silos?
A: Yes. They provide structural design for metal silos across different plants and materials (not one single project page): geometry, steel/aluminium, filling/emptying pressures, wind and seismic actions. See https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/silos-metallici/
